learner_operation: Read the signed coefficient and constant of the unknown in the exponent and the positive right-hand-side expression; derive the logarithmic value and isolate the requested unknown. The logarithm coefficient and constant in the response must follow those assignments.

fixed_features.feature: Base e and isolated exponential equals a positive integer RHS
fixed_features.justification: Tutorial 2806 uses the base-e inverse and exact ln answer; q-263058 directly supplies an integer RHS. Roots/powers are separately scoped sources.

fixed_features.feature: One blank for the RHS of the requested variable equation
fixed_features.justification: Complete moderate q-263058 has exactly this field contract.
Nonzero translation and nonunit division retain the moderate source stages. Small integer bounds retain comparable arithmetic. ln(1) and zero offsets would remove assessed stages; no sign is fixed.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Both signs and nonunit small integer magnitudes
answer_roles.observed: All 12 signed coefficients covered; relevant sign change negates response and updates native grading.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Both signs and small nonzero magnitudes
answer_roles.observed: All 18 signed offsets covered; offset change moves response by the independently expected rational amount.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Positive integer n with nontrivial ln, comparable source arithmetic
answer_roles.observed: Every integer 2..30 covered; changing 11 to13 changes prompt, solution, key and learner outcome.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: x/y/t and both term orders, irrelevant to numeric solution
answer_roles.observed: All names and both orders sampled; controlled rename/order preserve numeric answer and native acceptance.

counterfactuals.change: Hold a=-5,b=4,n=11,y,constant-first fixed, then separately change a to5, b to-4, or n to13.
counterfactuals.expected: Coefficient sign negates the response; offset sign changes translation by -8/5; RHS change changes logarithm by -(ln13-ln11)/5. Old response is rejected after each change.
counterfactuals.observed: Independent exact checks and real native grading agree in all three cases; displayed prompt and worked equations follow each changed value.
counterfactuals.justification: Signed exponent coefficients and RHS determine solution via the source natural-log and affine-solve stages.

counterfactuals.change: Hold a=-5,b=4,n=11 fixed and rename y tox or change constant-first to variable-first.
counterfactuals.expected: Numeric solution preserved; variable references or ordering in prompt and solution update; original numeric response remains accepted.
counterfactuals.observed: Both pairs preserve independently derived value and native acceptance; actual UI preview includes both changes.
counterfactuals.justification: The source asks for the variable value, so its name and algebraically identical term order cannot alter that value.

delivery.result: Independent132 ->129 accepted; runner5 ->5. All four sign cases remain in independently delivered pool. Selector is uniform conditional on eligible moderate pool and positive configured moderate weight; live histories/weights not captured.

limitations: Finite probes do not establish absence of every conceivable shortcut.
One moderate source profile supported; easy, hard, unrated radios and power-RHS canonical example are explicitly excluded.
Captured inventory basis4964 only. Later inventory changes and learner history/weights are outside the saved snapshot; selection conclusions are conditional as documented.
Renderer uses the real UI in correct-response preview mode, not a live lesson transaction. Native grading is database-free.
